@{5e44a1bd0c91c2477a8b8acb|full_name}: I'd prefer reset pose and such remain in the expression menu, that's where I'm in most of the time.

# Update:
With the planned change that was announced in yesterday’s  Development Update this seems to be even more important. 
```
We’ve changed the way you place/move the mirror around in the world.
Instead of being able to grab the mirror at any time and having a Lock option in the Action Menu, we’ve removed the Lock option and replaced it with “Move”. When you select that option, the mirror will be stuck to your hand and you’ll be able to move it around.
```
This means that every time you want to move the mirror, you need to first go to the Personal Mirror settings page. Which results in you needing to go that sub menu more often. With this change being able to get to it more quickly is even more important, so please consider moving it to the first page of the Action Menu.
i think is more of a place holder currently. once the big menu update comes out it likly will get moved there

@{5fca5df4d58780532024a52b|full_name}: Franada: When they added the second option in the quick actions, moving it to root were my exact thoughts. It would free up one slot in the expressions menu. 
The root might become more overwhelming, but there are so many functionalities in the action menu that you need to go to a sub menu of a sub menu anyway to access them. Having features buried behind many clicks produces a real chilling effect on people wanting to use them.
I think we should also be able to keybind it to quickly turn on and off
@{5fca5df4d58780532024a52b|full_name}: I really hate having to go back and forth through my menu so much, so this would be fantastic
@{5fca5df4d58780532024a52b|full_name}: That also kinda sucks if you aren't able to move it far away easily like it is rn.

We would like to spend more time designing an improvement over the current Action Menu system. After this, we plan on considering where the best place to put Personal Mirror would be. 
We're currently limited on resources at the moment for this task, so we'll keep this tracked for when we can work on it.
Addressed by creating the "Tools" section at the top level of the Action Menu.

details:
# Issue:
Right now, there the Portable Mirror is hidden in the `Options` category of the `Action Menu`. This results in it taking longer going from your normal Expression Menu to the portable Mirror and can result in accidentally pressing the wrong button because the `Options` sub menu is already relatively full.
# Suggestion:
The Portable Mirror is something people want to access fast, especially going from your Expression Menu to it and back. It’s also something new people should easily be able to find.
So my suggestion is to move it to the first page of the `Action Menu`, that way you make it easy to find and fast to access. The first page also only has 3 options currently, adding a 4th one should not add any clutter to it, it probably makes it even faster to use since with a thumb stick you can go up / down and right / left. (It also removes clutter from the `Options` which is already relatively full)
title: [1216] Move Portable Mirror to the first page of the Action Menu
